svg.title: Cedar access troubleshooting ladder
svg.desc: Diagnose "I can't see it" from the outside in. Step 1 sign-in: is the user enabled in Microsoft Entra ID and licensed? Step 2 environment: member of the environment security group and present in Dataverse; run diagnostics in the admin center. Step 3 app: is the app shared with one of the user's roles? Step 4 row: does a role, business unit, team, share or hierarchy grant the privilege at the needed depth? Use Check access or RetrievePrincipalAccessInfo. Step 5 column: does a column security profile grant read? Step 6 not a security issue: view filters, inactive status, propagation delay or data policy for flows. Each step lists the evidence to capture: audit history to find what changed.

g.text: Omar Test: "I can't see the chiller case" — check each rung, top to bottom
Entra account enabled? Licence assigned and synced?
Evidence: Entra sign-in logs, Microsoft 365 admin center licences
In security group Cedar CRM users? User row exists and enabled?
Evidence: admin center Users → Run diagnostics
Cedar Operations shared with Service Agent – Cedar? Any role at all?
Evidence: app sharing panel, Manage roles (direct + group team)
Privilege + depth via role, BU, owner team, access team, share?
Evidence: Check access on the record, RetrievePrincipalAccessInfo, Audit History
Secured column? Column security profile via user or team?
Evidence: profile Users/Teams tabs, field shares
View filter, inactive row, wrong app/form, cache, data policy on a flow
Evidence: switch to All view, Advanced find, flow checker
